_: Tripo Studio queue for the Kingsreach Colosseum (docs/COLOSSEUM_REDESIGN.md). style + prompt + tail is the text prompt; tris = retopology target; rig = humanoid auto-rig after retopo (crowd); tpose = generate in T-pose; task = Studio task id; status: queued | generated | retopo | rigged | exported | optimized | in-game.
style: Stylized hand-painted fantasy MMO game asset, chunky exaggerated proportions, bold readable silhouette, painterly textures, saturated colors.
tail: Single object, centered, no ground, no text.
